name: cccr
description: AI-powered Git code reviews using Claude Code

commands.title: Claude Code Review: Review Git Changes
Claude Code Review: Run Last Review Again

claudeCodeReview.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI. Leave as "claude" to find it on PATH and in the usual install locations.

claudeCodeReview.model.description: Model for reviews, such as "sonnet" or "opus". Empty uses your Claude Code default model.

claudeCodeReview.maxBudgetUsd.description: Stop a review once it has spent this many US dollars on API calls. 0 means no limit.

claudeCodeReview.timeoutMinutes.description: Give up on a review after this many minutes.

claudeCodeReview.defaultBaseBranch.description: Branch suggested when reviewing a branch against its base.
